payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for different discourse relations, indicating which types the model performs best and worst on.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance improvements on Comparison and Temporal discourse relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
The model performs poorly on implicit discourse relations overall, achieving a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%, which is lower than explicit relations that exceed 90% F1-score.
The CRF layer improves implicit discourse relation recognition but is not suitable for binary classification, indicating limitations in performance for certain relations.
